previous_statement: In the H0>0 case define phi(x)=s dot (x-y0). Then phi(x0)=H0, phi(y)<=0 for y in C, and the linear part has l_infty norm at most 1.
new_statement: In the H0>0 case, let y0 be the nearest point from 1.1.2.2 and let s be the support vector supplied by 1.1.2.3; define phi(x)=s dot (x-y0). Then phi(x0)=H0, phi(y)<=0 for y in C, and the linear part has l_infty norm at most 1.
